verdicts.reason: A breaks the composition: the can is pulled off the yellow circle and jammed into the top edge, 'Grab a Can' has lost its button and floats as plain text on the circle, the NEW FLAVOUR badge is squashed into an ellipse, and the badges and logo are scattered with no reading order. B keeps the original's structure and hierarchy, but it is mostly a shrunk copy: the ZERO SUGAR tag and the NEW FLAVOUR text are too small to read, the CTA and the FIZZBANG! logo are jammed against the bottom edge, and the circle crowds the right edge.
